summary: The most useful distinction when shopping for a UK OMODA 9 is not simply whether the exterior is dark. It is whether the offer actually describes the MY26 vehicle you intend to buy, and whether its comfort and controls suit the people who will use it. A Black Noble photograph can answer a styling question. It cannot establish which revisions are fitted or how the vehicle will feel on your roads.
